tea-time.title: Tea Time ☕
tea-time.description: Replace one coffee with black, green, or herbal tea today. Choose a time when you normally drink coffee.

lower-sugar-drink.title: Lower-Sugar Drink ☕
lower-sugar-drink.description: Prepare one coffee or tea with less sugar than usual. Use a sweetener only if it helps you make the smaller-sugar step.

try-sparkling-water.title: Try Sparkling Water ✨
try-sparkling-water.description: Swap one sweet drink for sparkling water with lemon, mint, or cucumber. Put it with a meal or study break so it is easy to remember.

blend-a-smoothie.title: Blend a Smoothie 🥤
blend-a-smoothie.description: What about blending coconut water with frozen fruit for one smoothie. Keep the portion simple and easy for yourself.

carry-your-bottle-of-water.title: Carry Your Bottle of Water 🫙
carry-your-bottle-of-water.description: Take a reusable bottle with you and refill it when you arrive somewhere new.

drink-a-glass-of-water.title: Drink A Glass of Water 🫗
drink-a-glass-of-water.description: Make a water drinking ritual, for example one after waking up and one during work, study, and before lunch. Log the glasses when you finish.

infuse-a-water-bottle.title: Infuse a Water Bottle 🥒
infuse-a-water-bottle.description: Prepare one bottle or jug of water with fruit, mint, cucumber, or lemon. Keep it nearby and drink it during your next routine block.

plan-this-week-s-meals.title: Plan This Week's Meals 🗓️
plan-this-week-s-meals.description: Write a simple plan for this week's breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Keep it realistic, using food you can actually prepare or buy.

buy-three-fresh-items.title: Buy Three Fresh Items 🥬
buy-three-fresh-items.description: Buy at least three fresh items, such as fruit, vegetables, or wholegrain bread. Choose a market, local shop, or your usual supermarket.

write-a-grocery-list.title: Write a Grocery List 🛒
write-a-grocery-list.description: Before shopping, write your shopping list including healthy items such as fruit, vegetables, or wholegrain bread. Take a photo or screenshot of the list.

share-a-meal.title: Share a Meal 🌮
share-a-meal.description: Invite someone for a simple meal, tea, or coffee. Choose a time that feels easy for both of you.

batch-cook-healthy-meal.title: Batch-Cook Healthy Meal 🍲
batch-cook-healthy-meal.description: Cook one healthy meal in a bigger batch so you have leftovers for later. Pack one portion for a busier day.

plan-meals-and-groceries.title: Plan Meals and Groceries 🗓️
plan-meals-and-groceries.description: Plan for a few meals for the week and write a matching grocery list. Keep it short enough to follow when you shop.

eat-a-peanut-spread.title: Eat a Peanut Spread 🥜
eat-a-peanut-spread.description: Use a 100% peanut spread instead of chocolate spread for one breakfast or snack.

eat-canned-fish.title: Eat Canned Fish 🥫
eat-canned-fish.description: For sandwich, salad, or quick meal, choose canned fish instead of processed meat.

eat-cheese-instead-of-processed-meat.title: Eat Cheese Instead of Processed Meat 🧀
eat-cheese-instead-of-processed-meat.description: Make one sandwich or meal with cheese and vegetables instead of processed meat.

eat-fish-once.title: Eat Fish Once 🍣
eat-fish-once.description: Replace one red-meat meal with fish this week. Keep the side dishes familiar so the swap feels manageable.

order-smaller-courses.title: Order Smaller Courses 🍽️
order-smaller-courses.description: At one meal, choose two smaller first courses or sides with little or no meat instead of a meat-heavy main dish.

pack-nuts-or-seeds.title: Pack Nuts or Seeds 🌰
pack-nuts-or-seeds.description: Prepare a small portion of nuts or seeds for later today. Put it in your bag, desk, or kitchen so it is ready.

add-nuts-to-a-meal.title: Add Nuts to a Meal 🥜
add-nuts-to-a-meal.description: Add a small handful of nuts to fruit, yogurt, or a salad. Keep the portion small and intentional.

make-a-protein-spread.title: Make a Protein Spread 🍘
make-a-protein-spread.description: Prepare a simple spread such as hummus, bean spread, or cottage cheese. Add it to toast, crackers, or vegetables.

swap-a-meaty-meal-for-legumes.title: Swap A Meaty Meal for Legumes 🍲
swap-a-meaty-meal-for-legumes.description: Replace one meat-based meal with beans, lentils, chickpeas, or another legume. Add vegetables or grains to make it filling.

swap-meat-for-eggs.title: Swap Meat for Eggs 🥚
swap-meat-for-eggs.description: Replace meat-based meals with eggs this week. Also, add vegetables, wholegrain bread, or potatoes if you like.

swap-sausage-for-fish.title: Swap Sausage for Fish 🐟
swap-sausage-for-fish.description: Replace a burger or sausage with fish. Choose a simple preparation you can actually make.

swap-sausage-for-poultry.title: Swap Sausage for Poultry 🍗
swap-sausage-for-poultry.description: Replace a burger or sausage with chicken or turkey. Add vegetables or wholegrains on the side.

add-grated-tofu.title: Add Grated Tofu 🫘
add-grated-tofu.description: Grate tofu into one simple meal, such as a wrap, stir-fry, salad, or pasta sauce. Season it well and keep the recipe easy.

eat-one-screen-free-meal.title: Eat One Screen-Free Meal 😌
eat-one-screen-free-meal.description: Have one meal without your phone, laptop, or TV. Sit down, slow your pace, and register the meal when you finish.

portion-dark-chocolate.title: Portion Dark Chocolate 🍫
portion-dark-chocolate.description: Cut or break dark chocolate into small pieces and choose one planned portion. Put the rest away before you start eating.

on-plate-eating.title: On-Plate Eating 🍽️
on-plate-eating.description: Serve one snack or meal onto a plate or bowl before eating. Avoid eating straight from the package.

eat-fermented-food.title: Eat Fermented Food 🥣
eat-fermented-food.description: Add one fermented food to a meal or snack, such as yogurt, kefir, kimchi, sauerkraut, or another option you like.

cook-beans-or-lentils.title: Cook Beans or Lentils 🧑‍🍳
cook-beans-or-lentils.description: Cook one simple meal with beans, lentils, or chickpeas. Use canned legumes if that makes it easier.

cook-gently-with-non-stick.title: Cook Gently with Non-Stick 🧑‍🍳
cook-gently-with-non-stick.description: Use a non-stick pan on low or medium heat for one simple meal. Avoid overheating the pan and use a soft utensil.

cook-tofu-this-week.title: Cook Tofu This Week 🧑‍🍳
cook-tofu-this-week.description: Try one tofu dish this week. Use a simple recipe with vegetables, grains, or a sauce you already like.

cook-with-stainless-steel.title: Cook with Stainless Steel 🧑‍🍳
cook-with-stainless-steel.description: Practice one simple food in a stainless steel pan. Warm the pan first, add a little oil, and keep the heat moderate.

choose-fruit-for-sweetness.title: Choose Fruit for Sweetness 🍉
choose-fruit-for-sweetness.description: When you want something sweet, choose sliced fruit, berries, or diced fruit. Make it ready before the craving moment if you can.

eat-fruit-instead-of-jam.title: Eat Fruit Instead of Jam 🍓
eat-fruit-instead-of-jam.description: Top bread, yogurt, or porridge with fresh fruit or mashed berries instead of sugary jam.

log-fruit-servings.title: Log Fruit Servings 📒
log-fruit-servings.description: Track each fruit serving you eat. Use a note, checklist, or app.

non-fried-snack.title: Non-Fried Snack 🥕
non-fried-snack.description: When you want a savoury snack, choose nuts, wholegrain crackers, raw vegetables, or fruit instead of a fried snack.

pack-one-fruit-snack.title: Pack One Fruit Snack 🍉
pack-one-fruit-snack.description: Put one piece of fruit in your bag, desk, or kitchen counter for a planned snack later today.

prepare-one-better-snack.title: Prepare One Better Snack 🍎
prepare-one-better-snack.description: Before snacking, pause and choose one simple option such as fruit, vegetables, yogurt, or nuts. Eat it slowly and log what you chose.

try-one-new-taste.title: Try One New Taste 😋
try-one-new-taste.description: Try a new food or drink experience that feels enjoyable, such as a new fruit, tea, recipe, or shared snack.

buy-seasonal-fruit.title: Buy Seasonal Fruit 🥭
buy-seasonal-fruit.description: Buy one seasonal fruit during your next shop. Put it somewhere visible so it is easy to grab.

try-a-different-fruit.title: Try a Different Fruit 🥝
try-a-different-fruit.description: Buy one fruit you do not usually eat and have it as a snack or dessert this week.

eat-one-veggie-portion.title: Eat One Veggie Portion 🥗
eat-one-veggie-portion.description: Eat a portion of vegetables in a meal today. This can be a side salad, raw vegetables, or extra vegetables in the dish.

log-veggie-servings.title: Log Veggie Servings 📒
log-veggie-servings.description: Track your vegetable servings for one day this week. A note, checklist, or app is enough.

add-fruit-to-salad-bowl.title: Add Fruit to Salad Bowl 🍎
add-fruit-to-salad-bowl.description: Add one fruit to a salad, such as apple, orange, berries, or pear. Prepare it as part of lunch or dinner.

build-a-better-sandwich.title: Build a Better Sandwich 🥙
build-a-better-sandwich.description: Make one sandwich with vegetables and a simple protein such as egg, cheese, hummus, tofu, or fish. Skip processed meat for this one.

eat-fresh-herbs.title: Eat Fresh Herbs 🌿
eat-fresh-herbs.description: Use fresh herbs in one meal this week, such as basil, parsley, cilantro, or mint. Add them at the end so the flavour stays bright.

season-one-simple-dish.title: Season One Simple Dish 🌶️
season-one-simple-dish.description: Add one spice or seasoning mix to a simple dish, such as eggs, vegetables, rice, or soup. Keep the salt modest and taste before adding more.

serve-veggies-on-the-side.title: Serve Veggies on the Side 🥗
serve-veggies-on-the-side.description: Add raw or cooked vegetables as a side dish for one meal. Choose something easy, such as cucumber, carrots, salad, or steamed vegetables.

try-a-veggie-recipe.title: Try a Veggie Recipe 🧑‍🍳
try-a-veggie-recipe.description: Cook one simple recipe where vegetables are the main part of the meal. Pick something that matches your taste and time.

buy-seasonal-vegetables.title: Buy Seasonal Vegetables 🥗
buy-seasonal-vegetables.description: Check which vegetables are in season and buy one you can use this week. Add it to a meal you already know how to make.

cook-a-colorful-plate.title: Cook a Colorful Plate 🧑‍🍳
cook-a-colorful-plate.description: Make one meal with at least three different colors from vegetables or fruit. Take a photo if you want to mark it.

cook-a-veggie-sauce.title: Cook a Veggie Sauce 🧑‍🍳
cook-a-veggie-sauce.description: Make one sauce where vegetables do most of the work, such as tomato, pepper, mushroom, or courgette. Use it with pasta, rice, or bread.

eat-wholegrain-snack.title: Eat Wholegrain Snack 🍘
eat-wholegrain-snack.description: Choose one higher-fibre or wholegrain snack instead of your usual sweet snack. Keep the portion small and planned.

read-ingredients-for-wholegrain.title: Read Ingredients for Wholegrain 🌾
read-ingredients-for-wholegrain.description: At your next shop, pick bread where wholegrain or whole wheat is clearly listed as a main ingredient. Add it to your basket and skip one refined option.

swap-one-pastry-for-toast.title: Swap One Pastry for Toast 🍞
swap-one-pastry-for-toast.description: Replace one sweet pastry with wholegrain toast and a topping you enjoy. Plan it for breakfast or an afternoon snack.

buy-wholegrain-bread.title: Buy Wholegrain Bread 🍞
buy-wholegrain-bread.description: Choose one wholegrain bread instead of white bread this week. Check a bakery, market, or supermarket shelf that fits your normal routine.

make-an-oat-breakfast.title: Make an Oat Breakfast 🥣
make-an-oat-breakfast.description: Prepare oats or a wholegrain cereal for one breakfast. Add fruit, nuts, or yogurt if you want it to feel more complete.

cook-one-wholegrain-meal.title: Cook One Wholegrain Meal 🧑‍🍳
cook-one-wholegrain-meal.description: Make one meal with wholegrain pasta, brown rice, quinoa, or wholegrain bread. Keep the recipe simple and add vegetables if you can.

cook-a-quinoa-meal.title: Cook a Quinoa Meal 🌾
cook-a-quinoa-meal.description: Cook one quick meal with quinoa, brown rice, or another wholegrain. Add vegetables and a protein you already like.

drink-decaf-after-lunch.title: Drink Decaf After Lunch ☕
drink-decaf-after-lunch.description: Swap one afternoon coffee or tea for decaf or herbal tea. Keep your usual cup ritual if that helps.

log-afternoon-caffeine.title: Log Afternoon Caffeine ☕
log-afternoon-caffeine.description: Track any caffeine you drink after lunch today. Choose one smaller or earlier cup if you can.

breathe-with-a-calm-image.title: Breathe with a Calm Image 🧘
breathe-with-a-calm-image.description: Pair slow breathing with a simple image, such as waves, clouds, or a quiet place. Practice for a few minutes.

mindful-pause.title: Mindful Pause 🧘
mindful-pause.description: Spend 3 to 5 minutes sitting, walking slowly, stretching, or breathing. Put your phone aside and focus on one thing at a time.

stretch-one-tight-area.title: Stretch One Tight Area 🤸
stretch-one-tight-area.description: Choose one tight area, such as shoulders, back, neck, or legs. Stretch it gently for a few minutes and breathe slowly.

take-a-box-breathing-break.title: Take a Box Breathing Break 🧘
take-a-box-breathing-break.description: Pause for a few minutes and breathe slowly. Try four seconds in, four seconds hold, and four seconds out.

write-down-emotion.title: Write Down Emotion ✍️
write-down-emotion.description: Pause once today and write one plain word for how you feel, such as tired, angry, calm, or sad. No need to judge it.

do-a-body-scan.title: Do a Body Scan 🧘
do-a-body-scan.description: Spend 5 minutes slowly noticing your body from head to toe. If you notice tension, breathe gently and move on.

plan-three-recharge-activities.title: Plan Three Recharge Activities 🗓️
plan-three-recharge-activities.description: Think of activities that give you energy or calm. Pick three and schedule a small version this week.

read-something-calm.title: Read Something Calm 📖
read-something-calm.description: Read a calm book or article before bed. Avoid intense or suspenseful content tonight.

schedule-a-short-rest-break.title: Schedule a Short Rest Break 🗓️
schedule-a-short-rest-break.description: Add a short rest break between two activities today. Use it to stretch, drink water, breathe, or sit quietly.

set-up-a-calm-spot.title: Set Up a Calm Spot 🧘
set-up-a-calm-spot.description: Pick a quiet place for a breathing, stretching, or mindfulness sessions. Make it ready before you start.

take-a-slow-breathing-break.title: Take a Slow Breathing Break 🧘
take-a-slow-breathing-break.description: Pause for a few minutes and breathe slowly. Try a steady rhythm and keep your shoulders relaxed.

play-a-guided-meditation.title: Play a Guided Meditation 🧘
play-a-guided-meditation.description: Choose one short guided meditation or audio practice and follow it for a few minutes. Stop when the timer ends.

write-one-difficult-thought.title: Write One Difficult Thought ✍️
write-one-difficult-thought.description: When a difficult thought or feeling appears, write it in one short sentence. Add one kind next step, then return to your day.

move-in-the-afternoon.title: Move in the Afternoon 🚶
move-in-the-afternoon.description: Take a short walk, stretch, or move around for a few minutes in the afternoon instead of reaching straight for a nap.

get-morning-light.title: Get Morning Light ☀️
get-morning-light.description: Soon after waking, open the curtains or step outside for a few minutes. Pair it with a short walk if you can. Avoid scrolling.

mute-non-essential-notifications.title: Mute Non-Essential Notifications 🔕
mute-non-essential-notifications.description: Turn off or silence non-essential app notifications for one work, study, or rest block today.

make-the-bedroom-screen-free.title: Make the Bedroom Screen-Free 📵
make-the-bedroom-screen-free.description: Move your phone, laptop, or tablet away from the bed tonight. Charge it outside reach if possible.

step-outside-for-fresh-air.title: Step Outside for Fresh Air 🌬️
step-outside-for-fresh-air.description: Spend a few minutes outside today. Walk, sit, or stand somewhere with daylight and leave your phone in your pocket.

block-distractions.title: Block Distractions 📵
block-distractions.description: Choose one app, site, or habit that pulls your attention. Mute it or move it away for one work, study, or rest block today.

eat-a-lighter-dinner.title: Eat A Lighter Dinner 🍽️
eat-a-lighter-dinner.description: Plan one lighter evening meal and avoid very heavy portions close to bedtime.

eat-dinner-earlier.title: Eat Dinner Earlier 🗓️
eat-dinner-earlier.description: Plan dinner a bit earlier than usual today. Leave some time between eating and bedtime.

write-one-good-thing.title: Write One Good Thing ✍️
write-one-good-thing.description: At the end of the day, write one good thing that happened and why it mattered, even if it was small.

write-one-small-joy.title: Write One Small Joy ✍️
write-one-small-joy.description: Write down one small thing that made you smile today, such as a song, view, smell, joke, or kind moment.

write-one-meaningful-action.title: Write One Meaningful Action ✍️
write-one-meaningful-action.description: Write one small action that connects to something you value, such as nature, care, learning, faith, creativity, or friendship.

write-three-gratitudes.title: Write Three Gratitudes 🙏
write-three-gratitudes.description: Write three things you are grateful for today. They can be small, ordinary, or unexpected.

plan-a-low-cost-outing.title: Plan a Low-Cost Outing 🗓️
plan-a-low-cost-outing.description: Choose one low-cost activity this week, such as a park, museum, gallery, or free local event. Add the time to your calendar.

schedule-one-enjoyable-activity.title: Schedule One Enjoyable Activity 🗓️
schedule-one-enjoyable-activity.description: Choose one simple activity you used to enjoy or still care about, such as music, drawing, walking, tea, or a hobby. Add a short time slot to your calendar.

breathe-before-bed.title: Breathe Before Bed 🧘
breathe-before-bed.description: Before sleep, try a few slow rounds of breathing. Inhale for four seconds, pause briefly, and exhale slowly.

do-a-short-wind-down.title: Do a Short Wind-Down 😴
do-a-short-wind-down.description: Before bed, spend 10 minutes on a calm routine such as reading, stretching, dimming lights, or preparing tomorrow.

plan-sleep-time.title: Plan Sleep Time 💤
plan-sleep-time.description: Choose a bedtime and wake-up time that give you enough time in bed. Add the bedtime to your calendar.

prepare-a-sleep-friendly-room.title: Prepare a Sleep-Friendly Room 😴
prepare-a-sleep-friendly-room.description: Choose one room adjustment before bed, such as dimming lights, reducing noise, clearing clutter, or cooling the room.

filter-blue-light.title: Filter Blue-Light  📵
filter-blue-light.description: Turn on the blue-light filter on your phone or laptop for the evening. Set it to repeat if your device allows it.

play-calm-sleep-sounds.title: Play Calm Sleep Sounds 🎶
play-calm-sleep-sounds.description: Put your screen away and play a calm sound, such as rain, waves, or soft white noise. Set a timer so it stops by itself.

set-a-repeatable-bedtime.title: Set a Repeatable Bedtime 😴
set-a-repeatable-bedtime.description: Pick a realistic bedtime and wake-up time for the next few days. Keep them close to your normal routine.

set-up-a-quiet-bed-reset.title: Set Up a Quiet Bed Reset 😴
set-up-a-quiet-bed-reset.description: Before bed, place a calm book or quiet activity nearby. If you stay awake for a while, use it outside the bed until you feel sleepy again.

turn-the-clock-away.title: Turn the Clock Away ⏰
turn-the-clock-away.description: Before bed, turn the clock face away or move it out of sight. Avoid checking the time if you wake up.

make-a-calming-drink.title: Make a Calming Drink ☕
make-a-calming-drink.description: In the evening, prepare herbal tea, warm milk, or another caffeine-free drink. Pair it with your wind-down routine.

stretch-before-bed.title: Stretch Before Bed 😌
stretch-before-bed.description: Do a few gentle stretches in the evening. Keep it light, slow, and comfortable.

take-a-20-minute-nap.title: Take a 20-Minute Nap 😴
take-a-20-minute-nap.description: If you need a nap, set a 20-minute timer and take it earlier in the day rather than late afternoon.

write-tomorrow-s-list.title: Write Tomorrow's List ✍️
write-tomorrow-s-list.description: Before bed, write down tomorrow's tasks or worries for a few minutes. Close the note or notebook when you finish.

set-a-podcast-sleep-timer.title: Set a Podcast Sleep Timer 🎙️
set-a-podcast-sleep-timer.description: Choose a calm podcast or audio and set it to stop after about 30 minutes. Put the phone away before you lie down.

list-three-support-people.title: List Three Support People ✍️
list-three-support-people.description: Write down three people who could offer emotional, practical, or friendly support. Pick one person you might contact.

say-hi-to-someone.title: Say Hi to Someone 😊
say-hi-to-someone.description: Greet one person you do not usually talk to, such as a neighbour, classmate, or colleague. Keep it short and friendly.

send-one-family-message.title: Send One Family Message 💬
send-one-family-message.description: Send a kind or practical message to one family member or close person. Keep it simple, such as checking in or sharing a small update.

care-for-one-friendship.title: Care for One Friendship 🫂
care-for-one-friendship.description: Remember one friendship you value and send a message, make a small plan, or share something thoughtful.

schedule-one-social-moment.title: Schedule One Social Moment 🗓️
schedule-one-social-moment.description: Plan one short social moment this week, such as a call, coffee, walk, message, or shared meal. Put it in your calendar.

send-a-friend-check-in.title: Send a Friend Check-In 💬
send-a-friend-check-in.description: Send a short message or make a quick call to ask how someone is doing. Keep it simple and genuine.

share-one-community-message.title: Share One Community Message 💬
share-one-community-message.description: Post one comment, question, or short update in a community space you already use. Keep it kind and low-pressure.

start-one-conversation.title: Start One Conversation 💬
start-one-conversation.description: Start one short conversation with a classmate, colleague, neighbour, or someone you see often. Ask one simple question and listen.

ask-one-person-for-support.title: Ask One Person for Support 💬
ask-one-person-for-support.description: Choose someone you trust and send a short message asking for support, advice, or a few minutes to talk.

plan-a-coffee-chat.title: Plan a Coffee Chat ☕
plan-a-coffee-chat.description: Invite someone for a relaxed coffee, tea, or short game moment. Pick a time and place that feel easy.

message-one-new-contact.title: Message One New Contact 💬
message-one-new-contact.description: Reach out to someone outside your usual circle with a short, friendly message. Suggest a simple next step if it feels natural.

choose-today-s-top-three.title: Choose Today's Top Three 📋
choose-today-s-top-three.description: Write your tasks for the day and circle the three that matter most. Start with one of them.

write-control-table.title: Write Control Table ✍️
write-control-table.description: Write one stressful situation and separate what you can control, what you can influence, and what you may need to let go.

add-one-personal-touch.title: Add One Personal Touch 🪴
add-one-personal-touch.description: Add one small comfort to your space, such as a plant, blanket, better light, or a tidy corner.

write-about-stressors.title: Write About Stressors ⚡
write-about-stressors.description: Choose one manageable stressor and write the next small action you can take. Make the action specific enough to do today or this week.

practice-one-clear-ask.title: Practice One Clear Ask 🙋
practice-one-clear-ask.description: Use one clear sentence today to ask for what you need or to say what you can offer. Keep it kind and direct.

use-task-tracker.title: Use Task Tracker 🎯
use-task-tracker.description: Use your notebook or notes app to track today's task. Write the date and one short line when you complete it.

write-one-kind-no.title: Write One Kind No ✍️
write-one-kind-no.description: Write one polite sentence for saying no to a request that does not fit your time or values.

tidy-up-for-5-minutes.title: Tidy Up for 5 Minutes 🧹
tidy-up-for-5-minutes.description: Set a 5-minute timer and tidy one small area. Walk, bend, reach, and keep moving until the timer ends.

clean-actively-for-10-minutes.title: Clean Actively for 10 Minutes 🧹
clean-actively-for-10-minutes.description: Spend 10 minutes on chores that keep you moving, such as sweeping, wiping counters, folding laundry, or tidying a room.

clean-actively-for-20-minutes.title: Clean Actively for 20 Minutes 🧹
clean-actively-for-20-minutes.description: Do 20 minutes of whole-body chores, such as sweeping, wiping, lifting laundry, or organising a shelf. Log it when done.

clean-actively-for-30-minutes.title: Clean Actively for 30 Minutes 🧹
clean-actively-for-30-minutes.description: Do 30 minutes of active chores, such as vacuuming, mopping, scrubbing, laundry, or tidying. Move steadily and take breaks if needed.

do-10-minutes-of-cardio.title: Do 10 Minutes of Cardio 💪
do-10-minutes-of-cardio.description: Choose one cardio activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, swimming, jogging, or a team sport. Keep moving for about 10 minutes at a pace that feels manageable.

do-15-minutes-of-cardio.title: Do 15 Minutes of Cardio 💪
do-15-minutes-of-cardio.description: Choose one cardio activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, swimming, jogging, or a team sport. Keep moving for about 15 minutes at a pace that feels manageable.

do-20-minutes-of-cardio.title: Do 20 Minutes of Cardio 💪
do-20-minutes-of-cardio.description: Choose one cardio activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, swimming, jogging, or a team sport. Keep moving for about 20 minutes at a pace that feels manageable.

move-for-10-minutes.title: Move for 10 Minutes 💪
move-for-10-minutes.description: Choose one movement you can do today, such as walking, cycling, stretching, or a short home routine. Add it to your calendar and log it.

do-30-minutes-of-cardio.title: Do 30 Minutes of Cardio 💪
do-30-minutes-of-cardio.description: Choose one cardio activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, swimming, jogging, or a team sport. Keep moving for about 30 minutes at a pace that feels manageable.

do-45-minutes-of-cardio.title: Do 45 Minutes of Cardio 💪
do-45-minutes-of-cardio.description: Choose one cardio activity, such as brisk walking, cycling, swimming, jogging, or a team sport. Keep moving for about 45 minutes at a pace that feels manageable.

log-each-walk.title: Log Each Walk 📒
log-each-walk.description: After each walk, mark it in your calendar or tracker. Add the time, route, or distance if you know it.

walk-a-new-route.title: Walk a New Route 🚶
walk-a-new-route.description: Choose a different route for one walk this week. Keep the distance comfortable and notice one new thing along the way.

walk-over-2-000-steps.title: Walk Over 2,000 Steps 🚶
walk-over-2-000-steps.description: Add a walk today and aim for more than 2,000 steps. Break it into two short walks if that fits better.

walk-somewhere-nearby.title: Walk Somewhere Nearby 🚶
walk-somewhere-nearby.description: Choose a nearby place you would often reach by bike, car, or bus and walk there instead. Keep it realistic for your day.

write-one-movement-step.title: Write One Movement Step ✍️
write-one-movement-step.description: Write down one small movement action you will do today, such as a walk, stretch, or two-minute workout. Add when and where you will do it.

add-five-walk-minutes.title: Add Five Walk Minutes 🚶
add-five-walk-minutes.description: Take one walk that is a few minutes longer than usual. Keep the pace comfortable.

schedule-a-30-minute-walk.title: Schedule a 30-Minute Walk 🚶
schedule-a-30-minute-walk.description: Plan one 30-minute walk to your calendar this week. Choose the day, time, and starting point now.

walk-4-000-to-6-000-steps.title: Walk 4,000 to 6,000 Steps 🚶
walk-4-000-to-6-000-steps.description: Go for 4,000 to 6,000 steps today. Add a walk after a meal or during a study break.

walk-one-routine-route.title: Walk One Routine Route 🚶
walk-one-routine-route.description: Take a usual route to work, campus, a shop, or a favourite spot on foot. Log the walk after you arrive.

make-one-trip-car-free.title: Make One Trip Car-Free 🚶
make-one-trip-car-free.description: Replace one short trip with walking or cycling today. Pick an errand or visit that is close enough to do safely.

try-walk-run-intervals.title: Try Walk-Run Intervals 🏃
try-walk-run-intervals.description: Walk for 3 to 5 minutes, then jog lightly for 1 to 2 minutes. Repeat a few rounds and stop before it feels too much.

walk-6-000-to-8-000-steps.title: Walk 6,000 to 8,000 Steps 🚶
walk-6-000-to-8-000-steps.description: Go for 6,000 to 8,000 steps today. Spread them across errands, breaks, and one planned walk.

walk-over-10-000-steps.title: Walk Over 10,000 Steps 🚶
walk-over-10-000-steps.description: Go for more than 10,000 steps today. Choose one longer route and add small walks where you can.

walk-over-8-000-steps.title: Walk Over 8,000 Steps 🚶
walk-over-8-000-steps.description: Plan enough walking today to pass 8,000 steps. Use a longer route or add two shorter walks.

do-morning-stretches.title: Do Morning Stretches 🌄
do-morning-stretches.description: After waking up, do gentle stretches such as arm circles, neck rolls, or leg swings. Move slowly for a few minutes.

log-how-movement-felt.title: Log How Movement Felt ✍️
log-how-movement-felt.description: After one activity, write one line about what you did and how you felt. Keep it quick and honest.

write-a-backup-plan.title: Write a Backup Plan 🗓️
write-a-backup-plan.description: Write one simple plan for a likely barrier. For example, if the weather is bad, do a short indoor routine.

plan-sitting-breaks.title: Plan Sitting Breaks 🗓️
plan-sitting-breaks.description: Check your calendar and find the times when you often sit too long and schedule 5-minute movement breaks for those moments.

plan-this-week-s-exercises.title: Plan This Week's Exercises 🗓️
plan-this-week-s-exercises.description: Add exercise sessions to your calendar with a clear day, time, and place. Keep it short enough to follow.

prepare-running-gear.title: Prepare Running Gear 👟
prepare-running-gear.description: Before your run or aerobic session, set out supportive shoes and comfortable clothes. Put them somewhere visible before the planned time.

tell-someone-your-plan.title: Tell Someone Your Plan 💬
tell-someone-your-plan.description: Send one message to someone you trust with your planned activity and when you will do it.

log-run-wins.title: Log Run Wins 🏅
log-run-wins.description: After run sessions, mark what you completed in your calendar or tracker. Add one short note about what went well.

plan-a-short-first-run.title: Plan a Short First Run 🏃
plan-a-short-first-run.description: Plan a simple first run, such as 10 to 15 minutes of easy jogging. Add the time and place to your calendar.

go-for-two-running-minutes.title: Go For Two Running Minutes 🏃
go-for-two-running-minutes.description: During one easy run, add one or two extra minutes if your body feels ready. Keep the pace comfortable.

run-with-easy-form.title: Run with Easy Form 🏃
run-with-easy-form.description: During this run, keep your shoulders relaxed, posture tall, and pace easy. Slow down when your form starts to slip.

prepare-your-workout-clothes.title: Prepare Your Workout Clothes 👟
prepare-your-workout-clothes.description: Put comfortable clothes and supportive shoes somewhere visible before your planned activity.

two-minute-workout.title: Two-Minute Workout 💪
two-minute-workout.description: Start with two minutes of movement, such as squats, marching, stretching, or push-ups against a wall. Stop there or continue if it feels okay.

7-minute-workout.title: 7-Minute Workout 💪
7-minute-workout.description: Set a 7-minute timer and choose simple moves such as squats, planks, push-ups, or jumping jacks. Move at a pace you can keep.

do-a-bodyweight-circuit.title: Do a Bodyweight Circuit 💪
do-a-bodyweight-circuit.description: Do a short circuit with moves such as squats, jumping jacks, push-ups, crunches, or lunges. Work for about 30 seconds per move and rest when needed.

stretch-for-5-minutes.title: Stretch for 5 Minutes 🤸
stretch-for-5-minutes.description: Set a short timer and stretch your shoulders, back, legs, or neck. Hold each stretch gently and breathe slowly.
